title: Sakkarai Devan
desc: A young jaggery merchant invites the ire of a prominent man after he unites the people against his corruption. Things get worse when he falls in love with a woman.

title: Ponn Vilangu
desc: Mallika falls in love with a police inspector, but when her older brother learns about it, he compels her to choose between her lover and himself.

title: Priyanka
desc: A lower-caste girl striving for social change rejects an upper-caste man, triggering deadly bigotry. Later, when her father is killed, a sudden natural calamity forces society to confront its divide.

title: David Uncle
desc: David, a small-time thief, transforms into a better person after his sister Mary disappears. He meets Devi, a girl and tries to navigate through several problems while trying to find his sister.

title: Paramasivan
desc: A man waits to meet his fate after being sentenced to death for killing six policemen. However, an officer asks him to help catch a terrorist group.
